up: Retrieve the exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614250. For each activity record, return the compound ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the standard activity type (standard_type), the exact relation (standard_relation), the standard value (standard_value), and the standard units (standard_units).
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614250' AND a.standard_relation = '='
